Every design decision must reinforce the heritage_classic aesthetic \u2014 formal, prestigious, warm, and storied \u2014 while maintaining the clarity and navigability expected of a modern card-grid layout family.\n\n**Overall Page Rhythm & Section Sequencing:**\nThe page flows through five distinct sections with deliberate tonal shifts: (1) a commanding full-viewport hero that anchors prestige, (2) a tight horizontal stats band that delivers authority through numbers, (3) a three-column feature card grid that communicates the academy's core pillars, (4) a testimonial card row that introduces human warmth and social proof, and (5) a richly textured full-width CTA close. Each section transition uses a subtle ornamental rule or a tonal background shift to create breathing room without breaking the formal register.\n\n**Background & Color Rhythm:**\nSections alternate between Crown Ivory (#F5F0E8) and Antique Linen (#EAE3D2) backgrounds to create gentle layered depth without sharp contrast breaks. The hero and CTA sections use Courtside Navy (#1B2A4A) as the dominant dark surface, bookending the page with gravitas. Our Story

A Club Built on Courts and Character

Since 1923, Courtside & Crown has shaped players and people in equal measure.

What began as a small grass-court club in the heart of the county has grown into one of the region's most respected tennis academies. Our walls carry the portraits of champions; our courts carry the footsteps of thousands of members whose lives were changed by the game.

Our History

One Hundred Years, One Unbroken Tradition

1923 — Founded

Courtside & Crown opens with four grass courts and thirty founding members on the Harrowfield estate.

1951 — First County Title

Our men's first team claims the county championship for the first time, cementing our competitive reputation.

1974 — Clubhouse Expansion

The iconic red-brick clubhouse is extended, adding a viewing terrace, lounge, and junior changing facilities.

1989 — Junior Academy Launched

A dedicated junior coaching pathway is introduced, producing three national-ranked juniors within a decade.

2003 — Indoor Courts Added

Two all-weather indoor courts ensure year-round play and open the academy to a wider community.

2023 — Centenary Season

Courtside & Crown celebrates 100 years with a centenary tournament, alumni weekend, and the launch of our scholarship programme.

Our Coaches

Guided by the Best in the Game

Every coach at Courtside & Crown holds LTA Level 3 or above certification and brings a passion for player development.

WA

Head Coach

William Ashford

Former ATP Challenger circuit player. William leads the performance squad and oversees all coaching standards.

LTA Level 5 Master Performance & Tactics
SM

Junior Development

Sasha Merritt

Specialist in 8–16 junior development with a decade of experience producing county-ranked players from grassroots beginnings.

LTA Level 4 Junior Development
FC

Adult & Beginner

Fiona Calloway

Renowned for her patient, encouraging approach, Fiona runs all adult beginner and improver programmes with infectious enthusiasm.

LTA Level 3 Adult Beginners & Improvers
MO

Strength & Conditioning

Marcus Obi

A certified S&C specialist who works with our competitive squads on physical conditioning, injury prevention, and athletic longevity.

UKSCA Accredited Athletic Performance

Find Your Place at the Club

Every membership includes full court access, club events, and the right to wear the Courtside & Crown badge with pride.

Junior

£195/ year

For players aged 8–17. Includes group coaching sessions, junior squad access, and inter-club match entry.

Adult Social

£320/ year

For recreational adult players. Full court booking access, club nights, and social tournaments year-round.

Best for Competitors

Performance

£580/ year

For competitive adults and advanced juniors. Priority coaching slots, performance squad sessions, and match analysis.

Best Value

Family

£895/ year

Up to two adults and three juniors under one roof. Full access to all programmes and a dedicated family match day experience.

Apply for Membership

Our Facilities

Courts Worthy of Champions

Eight courts, a storied clubhouse, and everything a serious player needs to thrive.

4 Grass Courts

Meticulously maintained to Wimbledon-standard specifications, open from May through September.

2 All-Weather Hard Courts

Available twelve months a year for training, club matches, and private hire.

2 Indoor Courts

Climate-controlled and floodlit, ensuring no session is ever cancelled by the British weather.

Heritage Clubhouse

A warm, members-only space featuring a lounge, bar, trophy room, and viewing terrace overlooking the grass courts.

Ball Machine Studio

A dedicated solo practice bay equipped with a professional ball machine for drilling at any time.

Fitness Suite

A compact on-site gym tailored for tennis-specific conditioning, used by our performance squad daily.

Do I need to be an experienced player to join?
Not at all. We welcome complete beginners of all ages. Our adult beginner programme and junior starter sessions are designed for players with no prior experience.
Can I try the club before committing to membership?
Yes. We offer a complimentary trial session for all prospective members. Contact the office to arrange a suitable time.
How do I enter a squad or competitive team?
Competitive squad places are allocated following a brief assessment session with our head coach. Contact the coaching team to arrange a trial.
Is the club suitable for children with disabilities?
Courtside & Crown is committed to inclusive tennis. We offer adapted tennis sessions and our facilities are accessible. Please contact us to discuss your child's specific needs.
Can I hire a court without being a member?
Non-member court hire is available at weekday off-peak times, subject to availability. Contact the office for rates and booking.
